owner_outcome: test source-faithful Hellenistic life-event rules as part of wider 16-tradition prospective blind matching research
ancient_one_way_assertion: If the Lot falls in specified signs, a man will take part in military campaigns
explicitly_not_asserted: If Lot is outside these signs, he will never take part in military campaigns

human_outcome_variable.name: participated_in_warlike_military_campaign_by_observation_cutoff
human_outcome_variable.potential_measure: Military service member formally deployed as part of organized armed conflict campaign, not simply peacetime training or conscription
human_outcome_variable.operational_yes: Verified organized-conflict military deployment documented by participant record or standard corroboration procedure fixed before predictions
human_outcome_variable.operational_no: Individual screened on full same observation window with no qualifying combat-theater operational deployment and adequate follow-up
human_outcome_variable.unknown: Missing service records, insufficient date/geography, unclear role or event classification
human_outcome_variable.birth_age_window: Development proposal: age 18 until cohort observation cutoff, with >=50 years of age recommended for opportunity time; exact cutoffs must be fixed before real recruitment
human_outcome_variable.equivalence_to_ancient_term: PARTIAL_MODERN_PROXY; not a claim that present deployments equal ancient campaigns
human_outcome_variable.further_secondary_endpoint: direct combat participation, only if separately preregistered

historical_sex_scope.wording: κεῖνος ἀνήρ (that man) in transmitted verse
historical_sex_scope.diversity_note: Any other-sex generalization requires separately frozen arm rather than assuming the ancient source covers everyone

cohort_proposal.eligibility: Adults with independent DOB/time/place and full observation window; recruit without knowing Lot exposure or military service history
cohort_proposal.independent_ascendant: Compute geographic Ascendant from independently validated time, birthplace, calendar, timezone, ephemeris, zodiac/obliquity convention
cohort_proposal.provenance_lock: Lock astronomical engine version, ephemeris hashes, tropical-vs-sidereal convention, ayanamsa where relevant, coordinates/time uncertainty and source version before exposure mapping
cohort_proposal.stable_classification: Require certified exposure stability across full declared birth-time and ephemeris uncertainty; sampled points alone never certify stability
cohort_proposal.strata: Birth decade, early-adult country/conscription policy, war/armed-conflict opportunity; define purely from pre-outcome official historic data
cohort_proposal.recruitment_prohibition: Do not recruit only soldiers or only known combatants, or use known owner/third-party biographies as blind cases
cohort_proposal.sample_size: Not fixed: estimate from independently sourced event prevalence and specify power/precision prior to preregistration, not after results

outcome_measurement.concealment: Person answering and adjudicator do not see birth-derived Lot placement, candidate predicted outcome or alternative versions
outcome_measurement.answer_freeze: Timestamp/hash complete human survey answers and support records before chart-exposure release
outcome_measurement.independent_verification: Adjudicate deployment documents where feasible without access to chart or anticipated answer
outcome_measurement.participant_protection: Consent and data minimization; no disclosure of military service details to other participants

primary_test_proposed.statistic: Risk difference in qualifying campaign proportion, indicated vs non-indicated
primary_test_proposed.alternate_literal_audit: Report all indicated people without observed campaign before cutoff explicitly, not discard as not-self or reclassify
primary_test_proposed.associated_null: No enrichment: identical outcome probability conditional on fixed strata
primary_test_proposed.method: Precommitted conditional outcome permutation across charts within matched conflict-opportunity cohorts; if exchangeability not credible, report descriptive only
primary_test_proposed.baseline: Within-stratum nonastrological prevalence model using cohort/sex/geography/opportunity variables; report improvement over that strong control, not just unadjusted enrichment
primary_test_proposed.multiplicity: Exactly one primary test of this locked candidate; revisions or additional signs create new development versions and require separate untouched cohort
primary_test_proposed.expected_uniform_indication_fraction: 4/12 = 1/3 under an independent uniform Lot-sign null, not claimed true prevalence or evidence
primary_test_proposed.significance: No p-value or NNT fabricated before actual participants; threshold to be fixed before preregistration
primary_test_proposed.adverse_stake: Do not use astrology to determine eligibility for military, safety, employment, military operations or trauma judgments

other_models.source_options: C29 monomoiria 360/120 source matrix kept separate; no conflation with lot of expedition
other_models.alternative_Taurus_context: Following modern Greek digital passage has Taurus campaign account; invalidates an exclusive outside-sign denial, not the one-way source
